name: Metal Products Co. Inc
old_description: At Metal Products, we have been a trusted name in the metal manufacturing industry since 1952. Our commitment to quality and personalized service sets us apart. We specialize in providing accurate and tailored metal sheet solutions for the roofing sector, ensuring precision and durability.
about:
Metal Products Co. Inc has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1952. The company is located at 1845 East Madison Street in downtown Phoenix. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The company manufactures a range of roofing accessories and provides custom sheet metal fabrication. Its product line includes drip edge, coping and wall cap, L‑metal, Z‑bar, flashing, valley, gutters, downspouts, scuppers, collector boxes, caps, pans, vents, spark arrestors, shrouds and custom panels. It also produces roofing sheets and offers custom fabrication for unique metal designs. Facility size, headcount and annual volume are not published.

Primary customers are roofing contractors and construction firms serving residential and commercial projects. The company states it serves the roofing sector with tailored metal sheet solutions.

Metal Products emphasizes transparent pricing, a customer‑centric approach and personalized service as its distinguishing factors. It describes its commitment to quality and precision as the reason it has remained a preferred choice for metal sheet requirements.
